notes.title: Tobii Horizon Playtest is over
notes.notes:
A huge thank you to everyone who has been testing, participating and submitted feedback. We've kept this playtest running over fairly long period while development have continued in the background. From this point this server is going into read only as we're concluding the test.

We'll soon™ have some really exciting news so please head over to our website, scroll to the bottom and sign up for our newsletter.
https://gaming.tobii.com/


Stay connected to the Tobii Gaming community over in our official Discord
https://discord.gg/tobiigaming
